The AI Industry Should Make Something People Want

Brian Judge

AI companies have alienated Americans by forcing them to bear the costs of their products while treating their consent as optional. With voters across the United States rejecting data centers, the incoming Congress has an opportunity to enact meaningful regulation and hold the industry accountable.

Allen J. Schaben/Los Angeles Times via Getty Images

Nov 11, 2026
5 min read

BERKELEY—When Sam Altman ran Y Combinator, the startup incubator’s motto for aspiring founders was to “make something people want.” As CEO of OpenAI, however, Altman has not followed his own advice.
